d:
An Air India flight from Kolkata to Mumbai was preparing for take-off when a chilling message was discovered on the mirror inside its toilet: a threat to hijack the plane at 11:10 AM. The pilot immediately alerted Air Traffic Control, and passengers were evacuated as the aircraft was moved to an isolation bay. Security teams searched the plane, but no suspicious object was found in the initial checks. Who wrote the message, and what was the motive behind it? The investigation is underway.
